claim: STH-SepNet with BERT backbone, adaptive hypergraph gate (--adaptive_hyperhgnn hgat, --fusion_gate adaptive, --static False), BIKE-Inflow, reproduces the paper's reported MAE/RMSE within the team's re-derived baseline
paper_reference: STH-SepNet KDD'25 Table (BIKE-Inflow MAE 5.18 / RMSE 14.40; these are sanity references, our own baseline is authoritative)
command_template: python run_main.py --task_name long_term_forecast --is_training 1 --root_path ./dataset/Bike/ --data_path inflow.csv --model_id BIKE_48_48 --model pool --data inflow --features M --seq_len 48 --label_len 48 --pred_len 48 --factor 3 --des Exp --itr 1 --d_model 768 --d_ff 32 --batch_size 16 --learning_rate 0.0001 --llm_model BERT --llm_dim 768 --llm_layers 6 --train_epochs 50 --gamma 1.0 --fusion_gate adaptive --enc_in 295 --dec_in 295 --c_out 295 --node_num 295 --scale_hyperedges 3 --seed <SEED> --num_workers 0
notes: MLP prediction head (FlattenHead). One run per seed; 3 runs total. The --num_workers 0 and DeepSpeed-off (STHS_USE_DS=0) are the single-GPU default.
